set(MOSS_AUDIO_DEPS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/.local/audio-deps" CACHE PATH "Native audio dependencies")
set(MOSS_MING_ROOT "${MOSS_AUDIO_DEPS}/ming" CACHE PATH "Pinned Ming-only audio.cpp C ABI")
if(NOT EXISTS "${MOSS_MING_ROOT}/include/audiocpp.h" OR NOT EXISTS "${MOSS_MING_ROOT}/lib/libaudiocpp.dylib")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Build the Ming runtime with python3 scripts/prepare_ming.py, or set MOSS_MING_ROOT")
endif()
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(VOICE_FFMPEG REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libavformat libavcodec libavutil libswscale libswresample)
if(NOT APPLE)
    find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
endif()
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED COMPONENTS core imgproc)
find_path(VOICE_JSON_INCLUDE nlohmann/json.hpp PATHS "${XINSHEN_SOURCE}/native/vendor" REQUIRED)
add_library(MossMingRuntime SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(MossMingRuntime PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${MOSS_MING_ROOT}/lib/libaudiocpp.dylib")
add_executable(moss-voice worker.cpp ../xinshen-ditto/media_io.cpp ../xinshen-ditto/avatar_runtime.cpp)
target_include_directories(moss-voice PRIVATE "${MOSS_MING_ROOT}/include" "${VOICE_JSON_INCLUDE}" ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(moss-voice PRIVATE MossMingRuntime PkgConfig::VOICE_FFMPEG ${OpenCV_LIBS}
    "-framework CoreFoundation" "-framework Foundation")
set_target_properties(moss-voice PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/workers")
if(NOT APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(moss-voice PRIVATE OpenSSL::Crypto)
endif()
